what: Activity log rows appear one by one starting at 1.4s — the dot grows from .8x and transparent over .4s, the content sharpens from a 4px blur and 4px below over .5s, and the line to the next row draws top to bottom. Interval is .8s for normal rows and .7s for comment rows (comment rows show content right at .1s, normal rows at .5s)

options.[data-fx-part=row]: One row (children, multiple) — data-kind="comment" Surface comment line tempo
options.[data-fx-part=dot] · [data-fx-part=body]: Dot in the line · content · line connecting to the next line (all optional)
options.start: Delay before the first line appears (seconds), default 1.4 — 0 for immediate
options.speed: Overall speed multiplier, default 1 — 2 means half the length (a panel opened and closed often in the app)
options.on: if view, plays when it enters the screen (default is right on mount)
options.view-start: on: view start position, default top 85%

from.where: index.html activity log in the Hero product panel (original problem-timeline: ue=1.4, item·comment advance .8·.7)
